title: KAPPLAKE LED spotlight

features: This lamp emits 65 lumens, which is approximately equal to the light emitted by a 15-watt incandescent bulb.
The light source has a lifetime of approx. 25,000 hours. This corresponds to about 20 years if the lamp is on for 3 hours per day.
Special waste handling may be required. Please contact your local authorities for more information.
You can power KAPPLAKE by connecting it to a USB-A port in your phone charger, computer, TV or power bank.
